intent: Turn yesterday's reporting, relationship, instruction and record residue into a new work decision where a compliant plan, veteran field knowledge and a jointly reset route each have real costs.
safety_floor: Keep workers out of the suspended-load travel and controlled swing area.
Maintain a clearly designated signal function and observable stop authority.
Do not treat veteran familiarity as a substitute for controls that a replacement worker can understand.

authoring_gate_checked.safety_floor: Suspended-load exclusion and signal control remain non-negotiable regardless of route.
authoring_gate_checked.field_accounts: Construction engineer, formwork foreman and crane signaler each hold partial field truth and are heard before the route is judged.
authoring_gate_checked.legitimate_pressure: Crane standby, delivery traffic, material stacking, crew familiarity and new support workers all affect workability.
authoring_gate_checked.route_costs: Plan route costs flow; veteran route costs transferability; shared reset costs time and coordination.
authoring_gate_checked.delayed_consequence: The first two lifts reveal whether the chosen control lives in the document, in one person's experience, or in a shared field standard.

presentation_rules: Do not label the documented route as foolish or the veteran route as reckless by default.
Do not make the jointly reset route cost-free or automatically superior in every future change.
Show that compliance and workability are related but not identical.
Make the 07:18 consequence observable in actual work behavior rather than a score badge.
